privateArtifact.format: Actual delivered HTML with embedded-data canonical JSON; no synthetic envelope.

notes: All 20 source JPEGs are byte-identical to the original ZIP. All 70 lossless crops match their source-rectangle RGB pixels. Display-only polygons exclude neighboring material without editing image pixels.

Original terminology, names and dates are retained. Five prose scans and one chapter/contents scan were visually transcribed. Two cross-page sentences were joined. Independent second-pass full proofreading is incomplete.

At 390x568/font26, long G240A gallery labels crowded the caption. Short positional tab labels fix this while preserving complete titles, captions, image labels and alt text. The final artifact passed 36 display conditions / 3163 screens, 21 UI checks and 210 all-asset views. Initial failure and QA-harness adjustment records remain private.
Six actual loader verify() cases passed using Node WebCrypto/Blob with DOM stubs. This is not browser IndexedDB, iframe integration or real iPhone testing; those checks are not run for this volume.
All 60 formal content certification checks remain not_run. Mechanical tests are not independent proofreading or real-device certification. Live public-URL browsing is unavailable.
Public files contain only the private-import shell and audit metadata. Book text and source/cropped images stay in private Drive files and on the user device.
